maddeler.e:
أنعتق (form VII)
# أَنْعَتِقُ (ʔanʕatiqu) /ʔan.ʕa.ti.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
# أَنْعَتِقَ (ʔanʕatiqa) /ʔan.ʕa.ti.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
# أَنْعَتِقْ (ʔanʕatiq) /ʔan.ʕa.tiq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْعَتَقَ (inʕataqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
